title: Logging, the sensible defaults
summary: Essential practices for production logging in cloud-native applications: structured JSON logging with context fields (request-id, transaction-id), actionable events only, central aggregation systems, and avoiding DEBUG logs and sensitive data in production. Distinguishes between logging and instrumentation per the Unix Philosophy's Rule of Silence.
when-to-read: Read this when setting up logging standards for a team or reviewing logging practices in a codebase that struggles with unclear or excessive logs. If you're trying to distinguish between logging for debugging versus instrumentation/metrics for performance monitoring, consult observability tag for more on instrumentation approaches.
